name: component-confidence-cap
description: A library analyzed with no consumer declared and every finding asked for. A published function only a test calls is reported as test-only use at possible, and the test that calls it is no test of dead code, because outside programs may call what it tests. An internal function only its test calls, and that test, are reported at certain, and a published function nothing calls is reported at possible while the internal function it calls is not reported.
